defects.title: /complete endpoint InProgress pre-check outside transaction
defects.invariant: Production batch completion must be atomic: InProgress check and stock effects execution must share a transaction or shared optimistic-concurrency guard.
defects.mechanism: ProductionManagementEndpoints.cs:149-154 fetches batch and checks batch.Status != InProgress, throwing InvalidProductionBatchTransitionException BEFORE calling stockEffectService.ExecuteBatchStockEffectsAsync at line 156. The check and the execution are separate await calls with no shared transaction scope. A concurrent second request passes the check (batch still InProgress), both enter ExecuteBatchStockEffectsAsync; the service's own idempotency (WasAlreadyExecuted) catches the second only if consumptions/output rows already exist. If the first request hasn't written them yet, both proceed — double status flip risk without shared optimistic-concurrency check.
defects.acceptance: InProgress check and ExecuteBatchStockEffectsAsync share a single transaction scope OR a shared row-version/optimistic-concurrency guard that causes the second request to fail with 409 before any stock movement.

limitations: Read-only analysis; no test execution. The service-side FOR UPDATE lock (ProductionStockEffectService.cs) mitigates double stock deduction but does not close the pre-check gap at the orchestration layer.
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
